newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Postal Savings suspends business with Nomura.
newsitem.headline: Japan Postal Savings suspends business with Nomura.

text.p: Japan's Postal Savings Bureau has suspended business with Nomura Securities Co Ltd after Japan's securities watchdog filed complaints against the brokerage house with prosecutors on Tuesday, a spokesman for the Posts and Telecommunications Ministry said on Wednesday.
He added that the suspension would continue for the time being.
The spokesman said the Postal Life Insurance Bureau (Kampo) had also suspended business with Nomura.

On Tuesday, the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission filed complaints with prosecutors alleging that Nomura, Japan's biggest brokerage, and three of its former executives illegally compensated a corporate client for losses.
